internal_silent.note: `ERROR` and `MISSING` are here for the same reason markdown has them: they are tree-sitter's UNIVERSAL parse-failure node types, not python constructs. The grammar emits them wherever a file does not parse, which makes them the parser's error channel rather than a member of the language, and an analyzer correctly derives no symbol from one. They were missing here, and the cost was concrete rather than cosmetic: section A reported "2 node type(s) in NO bucket: ERROR, MISSING", which is a FAIL, and section A is the first of the eight sections a language must pass to reach CONFORMANT. A lane can therefore be blocked from admission by two node types that belong to no language at all — and the diagnostic pointed at the classification rather than at the census, so the fix belongs in the classification.

gap._description: No analyzer emission gaps remain after the PYD1 deep review. Differential floor (cython:python): missing=0, unexplained=2 — the 2 are multi-file override resolutions (Nodes.py FuncDefNode.code_object / TryFinallyStatNode.nogil_check resolve against the harness companion index) that a single-file oracle cannot derive; same declared-limitation class as sqlite:c's 16.

design_decision.description: Python follows the scripting-family contract (module-level symbols ownerless) with managed-OO member-read use edges (PYD1).

decisions.question: self.x writes vs reads on the same `attribute` node type.
decisions.resolution: Writes emit Property symbols (deduped per class+attr, PYD1); reads emit `uses` with isMemberRead; assignment-LHS and call-function/receiver positions are excluded from uses. Pure AST by byte-range parent comparison.

decisions.question: Self-shadowing `class X(X)` (real cython IpythonMagic.py idiom).
decisions.resolution: extends to the same leaf name is suppressed (#299 name-collision fabrication rule); leaf retained in baseClasses metadata.

decisions.question: Uppercase-head calls could be classes or imported factories.
decisions.resolution: instantiates only when the name is declared in-file (declaredTypes); imported classes are external, no edge fabricated.

decisions.question: Nested functions and locals.
decisions.resolution: Nested function bodies attribute calls to the enclosing symbol; locals are never symbols (scripting-family contract).

decisions.question: Python 2 legacy statement nodes exist in the grammar but no legal Python 3 source produces them.
decisions.resolution: Grammar-internal: classified internal_silent; no analyzer path references them and none is fabricated.

decisions.node_type: method_signature / method_declaration / function_definition / def / sub (override resolution)
decisions.question: AnalyzeContext.overrideCompanion is never populated by production callers — what must analyzers that gate ALL override emission on it do for externally-declared bases?
decisions.resolution: M37.10 ruling (family-wide): the companion is optional enrichment, never a hard gate. Contract: in-file base declaring the method -> verified override (0.95 php/ruby/python/js/perl, 1.0 java/swift Pass-1); companion present -> companion-index resolution (0.85-0.9); otherwise deterministic Pass-3 first-parent guess at 0.5 with reasonCode 'first-parent-guess' and evidence tier 'inferred' — below the patterns.ts 0.7 threshold, counted as heuristic (honest suspicion) by the F5 differential. Gating on the companion alone silently dropped every cross-file override (php, ruby, python, javascript, perl); the inverse overclaim (swift guess at 1.0/structural) is equally a defect. Gated by F9-PROBE-M3710-* probes, per-language external-override fixtures + confidence pins, and 6 regression mutants.

decisions.node_type: isinstance/issubclass second-arg type reference (lowercase class-binding name)
decisions.question: OO family closure #613 (cython corpus Pipeline.py): isinstance(t, cls) where cls is a local class binding — is it a references edge?
decisions.answer: No — the analyzer PRIMITIVES excludes self/cls from type-name references; the derivePythonEdges isinstance branch lacked self/cls in its exclusion list, fabricating references:cls noise. Oracle mirror fixed (also on the assignment/return-annotation reference branches for consistency). oracle-only fix; pinned by the F5 lane itself.
